demoBanner.body: Ranges use editable illustrative assumptions and public average rates where available. Eligibility, APR, fees, and program terms depend on credit review and provider terms. Debt-resolution style programs carry extra risks (credit impact, possible taxes, fees, no guaranteed settlements) — see the notes below the table.

programCaveats.heading: Before considering a debt-resolution style program
items: These programs usually ask you to stop paying your creditors and save into a dedicated account instead. Missed payments can lower your credit scores and lead to late fees, added interest, collection activity, or lawsuits.
Creditors are not required to settle, and some may not. Not all enrolled debts may be resolved, and results are not guaranteed.
Program fees are part of the cost. Forgiven debt may be treated as taxable income; consider talking to a tax professional.
Programs are not available in every state, and eligibility and terms vary by provider.
The program row above is a flat illustrative assumption (total cost as a % of debt), not an estimate of any provider’s results.
